description: Lists recent browsing history entries, optionally filtered by a keyword.

fleetId.description: Fleet ID whose browsing history should be queried.

query.description: Optional text matched against history title, URL, or origin.

limit.description: Maximum recent history entries to return.

purpose.description: Describe why you are viewing browsing history, e.g., revisiting a previously accessed page
